name: Linked disc assembly
summary: A dress made of plastic or metal discs that small rings link together, with no cloth and no thread.
how: Cut or stamp discs of plastic or metal, 5 to 8 cm across, each with holes.
Join each disc to its neighbours with small metal rings, using pliers.
Shape the sheet to the body with a few darts of rings, and add a plain lining at the neck and the armhole.

origin.note: Paco Rabanne shows 12 Unwearable Dresses in Contemporary Materials, made of plastic discs and metal rings.

adoptions.via: Paco Rabanne links plastic and aluminium discs into short dresses, and the Space Age couture takes metal as a cloth.
